text_blocks.snippet: A Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (CDCES) is a healthcare professional with specialized knowledge and experience in diabetes management, education, and support. The CDCES credential, previously known as Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE), demonstrates expertise in diabetes prevention, prediabetes, and management across the lifespan.
